$comment: How BC Transit's Fraser Valley routes are drawn where the GTFS alone doesn't say; every route in the feed is drawn by default (school specials 22, 24 and 26 included), and the format is in config/feeds/translink/routes.json. No overrides: every route, the 66 Fraser Valley Express included, is coloured by frequency (the 66 in its own colour was too distracting, a long route in a thick bright line).
